detailed_description: WebSocket Tester is a browser-based tool for opening a ws:// or wss:// connection, sending text messages, and watching sent, received, and system messages in a timestamped history panel. It includes quick-connect examples, connection status feedback, disconnect and clear controls, and URL normalization before the browser WebSocket API is used. Messages are exchanged between your browser and the endpoint you choose.
usage_steps: Enter the WebSocket server URL (ws:// or wss://)
Click Connect to establish the WebSocket connection
Type your message in the input field
Click Send to transmit the message to the server
View received messages in the message history panel
usage_examples: Test WebSocket echo servers to verify connection functionality
Debug real-time chat application message handling
Monitor live data feeds from WebSocket APIs
Verify WebSocket server responses during development

faqs.question: Is the WebSocket Tester free?
faqs.answer: Yes. The tester runs in the browser and does not require an account.

faqs.question: Can I use ws:// and wss:// URLs?
faqs.answer: Yes. The URL field accepts standard WebSocket URLs and normalizes the value before connecting.

faqs.question: Where do my messages go?
faqs.answer: Messages are sent from your browser to the WebSocket endpoint you connect to. Do not send secrets to a server you do not control or trust.

faqs.question: Does it support custom headers?
faqs.answer: No. Browser WebSocket connections do not expose arbitrary custom request headers from this page.
